rationale.conceptual: An established but non-trivial computational method (DFT with plane-wave pseudopotentials, slab models) requiring careful implementation of multiple interacting components: building pristine and defective surfaces, handling physisorbed and decomposed states, applying entropy corrections for Gibbs free energy, and computing DOS. Not a textbook operation but not a novel algorithm.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline (~4–6 stages): generate multiple slab coordinates, run separate DFT total-energy calculations for each configuration, compute derived thermodynamic quantities, and assemble DOS data from relaxed geometries. Requires orchestration of QUANTUM-ESPRESSO runs and post-processing, but inputs are tiny (crystal structure, standard pseudopotentials).
